mapper.update: UPDATE users SET password = #{password} WHERE studentid = #{studentId}
mapper.select: SELECT postid, writerid, title, capacity, acceptedcount, kwsmoking, kwsleeptime, kwsensitivity, kwaircon, kwclean, status, content, createat FROM post WHERE writerid = #{writerId} ORDER BY createat DESC

SELECT a.applyid, a.postid, a.introduction, a.status, a.createat, u.studentid, u.nickname, u.name, u.major, u.profileimg, u.namepublic, u.studentidpublic, u.majorpublic FROM apply a JOIN users u ON u.studentid = a.applicantid WHERE a.postid = #{postId} AND a.status IN ('PENDING', 'ACCEPTED') ORDER BY CASE a.status WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, a.createat
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET acceptedcount = NVL(acceptedcount, 0) + 1 WHERE postid = #{postId}
mapper.select: SELECT postid FROM post WHERE postid = #{postId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET status = #{status} WHERE postid = #{postId}
UPDATE apply SET status = 'REJECTED' WHERE postid = #{postId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT applicantid FROM apply WHERE postid = #{postId} AND status = 'ACCEPTED' ORDER BY createat

SELECT g.groupid, g.capacity, g.academicyear, g.semester, g.status FROM groups g JOIN group_member m ON m.groupid = g.groupid WHERE m.studentid = #{studentId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN g.status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, g.academicyear DESC, g.semester DESC, g.groupid DESC

SELECT u.studentid, u.nickname, u.name, u.major, u.profileimg, u.namepublic, u.studentidpublic, u.majorpublic FROM group_member m JOIN users u ON u.studentid = m.studentid WHERE m.groupid = #{groupId} ORDER BY u.studentid
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM group_member WHERE groupid = #{groupId} AND studentid = #{studentId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM leavegroup WHERE groupid = #{groupId} AND requesterid = #{studentId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM chat WHERE writerid = #{studentId} OR applyid IN (SELECT applyid FROM apply WHERE applicantid = #{studentId}) OR applyid IN (SELECT a.applyid FROM apply a JOIN post p ON p.postid = a.postid WHERE p.writerid = #{studentId})
mapper.update: UPDATE leavegroup SET requesterid = NULL WHERE requesterid = #{studentId}
UPDATE role SET assigneeid = NULL WHERE assigneeid = #{studentId}
UPDATE settlementlist SET payerid = NULL WHERE payerid = #{studentId}
